engineer for information, access or an action counts. Automated acknowledgments, auto-replies and

Exclusions"],"text":"Only these two exclusions exist. No other circumstance excuses a missed target.

designated support contacts a written notice stating the window's start and end and the products
affected, at least **5 business days** before the window starts. Count the

recorded in Northstar Service with an MN-nnnn number; with no notice record there is no exclusion.

opened inside the window starts both clocks at the window's end (on a business-hours clock, at the
later of the window's end and the next start of business hours). Time after the window counts

Customer obligations"],"text":"7.1 The customer must report a Severity 1 incident by telephoning the Support hotline, (312) 555-0187,

Northstar to the customer.

the window: **30 calendar days** after the restoration date (the day after is day 1).

7.3 The customer must provide the information and access Northstar needs, and on a Severity 1
ticket keep a technical contact reachable by telephone until restoration."}],"total":12}

{"items":[{"doc_id":"b12e71cf-cafa-4cf8-b96a-1d05ed66fb5b","seq":1,"headings":["Support Severity Guide"],"text":"Northstar Support classifies severity from the business impact recorded in the ticket (its
description and notes). Test the definitions in order; the severity is the first one the recorded
impact meets."},{"doc_id":"b12e71cf-cafa-4cf8-b96a-1d05ed66fb5b","seq":2,"headings":["Support Severity Guide","Severity 1: Critical"],"text":"A Northstar product failure that, with **no workaround available**, either (a) stops the customer's
production or operations (a production line, a plant process, or a distribution, dispatch or
facility-operations activity cannot continue), or (b) makes NS-Cloud unavailable to **all** of the
customer's users."},{"doc_id":"b12e71cf-cafa-4cf8-b96a-1d05ed66fb5b","seq":3,"headings":["Support Severity Guide","Severity 2: High"],"text":"Not Severity 1, and any one of: (a) production or operations continue but are materially degraded;
(b) a control, alarming or condition-monitoring function is unavailable (not merely intermittent)
for one or more machines, lines, buildings or sites, whether or not the customer covers it with
manual checks; (c) NS-Cloud is unavailable to some, but not all, of the customer's users or sites;
(d) a Severity 1 condition with a workaround in place that needs ongoing manual effort."},{"doc_id":"b12e71cf-cafa-4cf8-b96a-1d05ed66fb5b","seq":4,"headings":["Support Severity Guide","Severity 3: Medium"],"text":"Not Severity 1 or 2: a function is impaired with no reduction in production output and no loss of a
control, alarming or monitoring function (intermittent faults with backfilled data, slow
performance, a failing report, a single-user error)."},{"doc_id":"b12e71cf-cafa-4cf8-b96a-1d05ed66fb5b","seq":5,"headings":["Support Severity Guide","Severity 4: Low"],"text":"A question, how-to, documentation issue, cosmetic defect or enhancement request, with no effect on
operations."},{"doc_id":"b12e71cf-cafa-4cf8-b96a-1d05ed66fb5b","seq":6,"headings":["Support Severity Guide","Who decides"],"text":"The customer's reported priority (P1 to P4) is only the customer's view: it does not set the
severity and has no effect on targets, credits or escalations. Northstar may correct the severity
up or down at any time. If the impact recorded at opening meets a different severity, that severity
governs from the open time, with its clock, targets, credits and escalations. If the impact changes
after opening, the ticket is reclassified at the moment the change is recorded."}],"total":6}

tied to the response on the response clock, deadlines tied to restoration on the restoration clock
(paused time does not count), and a qualifying maintenance window delays both. The customer-caused
exclusion and the telephone rule do not affect escalation. Each deadline is the latest compliant
time. "Engage" means assign the person to the ticket and confirm it there; "notify" means send a
message recorded in the ticket. Thresholds use the restoration target of the ticket's schedule
version."},{"doc_id":"2ec9d1dd-8f5b-4bb7-bd62-8d505a431c37","seq":2,"headings":["Support Escalation Procedure","Severity 1"],"text":"1. Engage the **Support Escalation Manager** as incident lead no later than 15 minutes after clock
   start.
2. Notify the **account owner** (as recorded in Northstar CRM) no later than 30 minutes after clock
   start.
3. If the ticket is not restored when 50% of the restoration target has elapsed, notify the
   **Director of Customer Support** no later than that moment.
4. If the ticket is not restored when 100% of the restoration target has elapsed, notify the
   **VP Sales** no later than that moment, and, for a **Strategic** account (CRM account tier), the
   **Chief Revenue Officer** as well."},{"doc_id":"2ec9d1dd-8f5b-4bb7-bd62-8d505a431c37","seq":3,"headings":["Support Escalation Procedure","Severity 2"],"text":"1. If there has been no initial response when the response target elapses, notify the **Support

   Customer Support** and the **account owner** no later than that moment."},{"doc_id":"2ec9d1dd-8f5b-4bb7-bd62-8d505a431c37","seq":4,"headings":["Support Escalation Procedure","Severity 3 and 4"],"text":"On a Severity 3 ticket not restored when the restoration target elapses, notify the **Support
Escalation Manager** no later than that moment. Severity 4 has no escalation."},{"doc_id":"2ec9d1dd-8f5b-4bb7-bd62-8d505a431c37","seq":5,"headings":["Support Escalation Procedure","Tickets outside a support agreement"],"text":"A ticket is in scope only if its customer (identified by CRM account id, ERP customer id or DUNS,
never by name alone) has a support agreement covering the ticket's product, and the ticket was
opened on or after the coverage start. Out-of-scope tickets are handled best effort: severity is
classified only for internal priority, no targets apply (nothing can be breached and no credit is
owed), and the escalations above do not apply. Northstar Support must notify the **account owner**
of the ticket's CRM account no later than 10 business hours after the open time. Any credit claim
is declined, and the decision is sent as for any claim."},{"doc_id":"2ec9d1dd-8f5b-4bb7-bd62-8d505a431c37","seq":6,"headings":["Support Escalation Procedure","Root cause and claims"],"text":"When Northstar asserts the customer-caused exclusion, the **Support Engineering Lead** records the
root-cause finding by the deadline in the Service Level Schedule. For every credit claim, the
**Director of Customer Support** sends the written decision, and for an approved credit the
**Support Billing Manager** issues the credit memo, by the deadlines in the Service Level Schedule."},{"doc_id":"2ec9d1dd-8f5b-4bb7-bd62-8d505a431c37","seq":7,"headings":["Support Escalation Procedure","When a decision can't be made"],"text":"A determination can't be made when a fact it depends on is missing from the ticket record and no
default applies: the customer's identifiers when names are ambiguous, the open time, the
initial-response time, the restoration time, the business-impact description, or a root-cause
finding while one is pending. Record "cannot decide: missing X" for it and for everything that
depends on it, and make all the other determinations. These have defaults: no recorded pause means
no pause; no notice record means no maintenance exclusion; an exclusion not asserted does not apply;
no telephone report recorded means none was made; no claim yet means no credit is owed yet (state
the credit that would be owed and the last day to claim it)."}],"total":7}

**Decision for SR-39881: `BREACH_CREDIT_OWED`.** The ticket is true Severity 2. Both the response and restoration targets were missed, and Northstar owes Blue River Logistics a **$200.00** service credit.

**1. Customer.** The ticket is under CRM account CRM-2051 ("BlueRiver Logistics"). That account's DUNS is 07-331-9025, which matches ERP customer C-1002, Blue River Logistics LLC, and the DUNS in the support terms (SUP-BRL-2025). They are the same customer.

**2. Scope: in.** The support terms cover NS-Cloud (NS-CLOUD) on the Silver plan. Coverage started 2025-01-01, and the ticket was opened 2026-08-20.

**3. True severity: Severity 2.** The customer reported it as P2, but that doesn't set severity. NS-Cloud's alerts and dashboards stopped at 2 of 6 depots, and dispatchers kept working by phoning drivers. Operations didn't stop and not all users lost access, so it isn't Severity 1. It is Severity 2 because an alerting function was unavailable at some sites (severity guide 2(b)), even though the customer covered it manually.

**4. Schedule and targets.** The ticket opened 2026-08-20 19:45 CDT, so Schedule v2.0 applies (tickets opened on or after 2026-04-01). Severity 2 on Silver means 2 business hours to respond and 12 business hours to restore. Business hours are 08:00–18:00 CT, Monday to Friday, excluding holidays.

**5. Clock start, pauses and exclusions.** The ticket opened Thursday evening, outside business hours, so both clocks start Friday 2026-08-21 at 08:00 CDT. There is no holiday on 08-21 or 08-24. No pause is recorded. The only maintenance notice for this account (MN-2607) covered July, and no customer-caused exclusion was asserted.

**6. Measurement.**
- **Response: missed.** The target ran out at 2026-08-21 10:00. The first engineer comment came at 10:20, 2 h 20 min of business time.
- **Restoration: missed, band 1.** Friday gives 10 business hours, so the target ran out Monday 2026-08-24 at 10:00. Restoration was at 10:40, 12 h 40 min of business time. That is over the target but within twice the target (24 h), which puts it in band 1.

**7. Credit.**
- The rates are 3% for the missed response and 5% for restoration band 1, so 8% of the $2,500 August fee, which is $200.00.
- The August cap is 30%, or $750. No other credits exist for tickets this customer opened in August, so the full $200 stands.
- The claim was timely. It arrived by email on 2026-08-28, named the ticket, and the deadline was 2026-09-23 23:59 CT.

**8. What Northstar owes:**

| Duty | Holder | Latest time |
|---|---|---|
| Notify the Support Escalation Manager (no response by the response deadline) | Hannah Lindqvist | 2026-08-21 10:00 CDT |
| Notify the Director of Customer Support (not restored by the restoration deadline) | Marcus Adeyemi | 2026-08-24 10:00 CDT |
| Notify the account owner (same trigger) | Kelly Floyd | 2026-08-24 10:00 CDT |
| Send the written claim decision (approve $200.00) | Marcus Adeyemi, Director of Customer Support | 2026-09-27 |
| Issue the $200.00 credit memo against the next support invoice | Paul Brennan, Support Billing Manager | 2026-09-27 |

No root-cause finding is due, because no exclusion was asserted. All these deadlines have passed (today is 2026-10-18). The record shows neither the notifications nor the claim decision and memo, so check whether they actually happened.

**What the customer must do:** nothing more. It isn't Severity 1, so no hotline phone report was needed, and the claim duty was met on time. It must still provide information and access if Northstar asks.
